rows.name: Morphology
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The histological classification of the neoplasm tissue (histopathological type) and a description of the course of development that a tumor is likely to take, e.g. benign or malignant (behavior).
It SHALL be present IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient”, Otherwise NOT present.
Note: Morphology codes do not contain decimals (.); the (/) is not counted as a character, and the last character can be only 0,1,2,3 6 or 9.
Element “Identifier” SHALL be present and SHALL be set to a value out of CS-Clinical-PrincipalDiagnosis value set (“code”).
Element “Text” MAY be present and SHALL be provided with the displayName of the code in “Identifier”
Element “Name of Coding System” SHALL be present and SHALL be set to “2.16.840.1.113883.6.135”
An “alternate” code MAY be present. If present, the following constraints apply:
Element “Alternate Identifier” SHALL be present
Element “Alternate Text” MAY be present and SHALL be provided with the displayName of the code in “Alternate Identifier”
Element “Name of Alternate Coding System” SHALL be present
The following fields lengths are accepted:
Field
Length
Identifier
50
Text
2000
Name of Coding System
﻿100
Alternate Identifier
50
Alternate Text
2000
Name of Alternate Coding System
100
Example: |M8010/3^Carcinoma, NOS^2.16.840.1.113883.6.135|

rows.name: Condition Onset Flag
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: A qualifier for each coded diagnosis to indicate the onset of the condition relative to the beginning of the episode of care.
It SHALL be present IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient”, Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of the “CS-Clinical-ConditionOnsetFlag” value set.

rows.name: Hajj Season flag
rows.guidanceAfter:
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN and used to report any person seeking medical service during the Hajj season regardless of his/her status in relation to performance of Hajj duties or nationality and travel area.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-HajjFlag” value set.

rows.name: Specialty on Admission
rows.guidanceAfter: This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN and contain the Admitting Consultant’s Specialty and SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-Speciality” value set.

rows.name: Specialty at Discharge
rows.guidanceAfter: This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN and contain the Discharging Consultant's Specialty and SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-Speciality” value set.

rows.name: Care provision modality
rows.guidanceAfter:
This field indicates the modality through which care was provided during the encounter.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="outpatient" (or) “Inpatient” (or) "primary care”), Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-CareModality” value set

rows.name: Care type
rows.guidanceAfter:
This field indicates nature of clinical service provided to an admitted patient during an episode of care, acute vs. sub-acute.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient”, Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-CareType” value set.

rows.name: Readmission flag
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: Re-admission is defined as a unplanned subsequent hospital admission in the same or different hospital for the same condition within 30 from previous discharge date.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient”, Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-ReadmissionFlag” value set.

rows.name: Neonate Admission Weight
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The admission weight of the neonate (age < 1 year) recorded in grams.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient” AND age is less than 1 year, Otherwise NOT present.

rows.name: BMI
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: Body mass index is a value derived from the
mass and height of a person. The BMI is defined as the body mass divided by the square of the body height.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient”, (or) “Outpatient”, (or) “Primary care”, Otherwise NOT present.

rows.name: ED Arrival Date/Time
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The Date/Time of patient arrival to emergency department.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Emergency", Otherwise NOT present.
Value SHALL be no later than or equal admit date/time.
The precision SHALL include time and time zone offset is required.
Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS+/-ZZZZ
Example: |20231217051200+0300|

rows.name: ED Arrival Mode
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The mode of transport by which the person arrives at the emergency department.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Emergency", Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-EDArrivalMode” value set.

rows.name: ED Service Commencement Date/Time
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The date/time on which non-admitted patient emergency department clinical care commences.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Emergency", Otherwise NOT present.
The precision SHALL include time and time zone offset is required.
Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS+/-ZZZZ
Example: |20231217051200+0300|

rows.name: ED Disposition
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The status of the patient at the end of the non-admitted patient emergency department service episode
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Emergency", Otherwise NOT present.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Primary care" AND (Primary care reason for visit = urgent care), Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-EDDisposition” value set.

rows.name: Triage Date /Time
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The date/time on which the patient is triaged.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Emergency", Otherwise NOT present.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Primary care" AND (Primary care reason for visit = urgent care), Otherwise NOT present.
The precision SHALL include time and time zone offset is required.
Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS+/-ZZZZ
Example: |20231217051200+0300|

rows.name: Triage Category
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: The category assigned to a patient as a result of an initial assessment by medical or nursing staff in an Accident and Emergency Department. The triage category is used to determine the patient's priority for treatment, and to inform the patient of their waiting time
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Emergency", Otherwise NOT present.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Primary care" AND (Primary care reason for visit = urgent care), Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-TriageCategory” value set.

rows.name: Initial or Subsequent Service Event
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: An indicator of whether the service event is the first service event for a new referral or a follow up service event.
This field SHALL be required IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="long term care" (or) “dental” (or) “mental” (or) “Primary care” (or) “Outpatient”, Otherwise NOT present.
It SHALL contain a value out of “CS-Adm-EventType” value set.

rows.name: Patient complexity level
rows.guidanceAfter:
Definition: A complex patient is one who needs more time to achieve the same level of care as a patient who is not clinically complex.

rows.name: Patient out on Pass Start Date/Time

The precision SHALL include time and time zone offset is required.
Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS+/-ZZZZ
Example: |20231217051200+0300|

rows.name: Patient out on Pass End Date/Time
rows.guidanceAfter:

It SHALL be present IF KNOWN when discharging a patient (MSH.9 Message Type = “ADT^A08”) AND (Patient class PV1.2="Daycase" (or) “Inpatient”, Otherwise NOT present.
Value SHALL be later than Patient out on Pass Start Date/Time.
The precision SHALL include time and time zone offset is required.
Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS+/-ZZZZ
Example: |20231217051200+0300|

rows.name: Critical care Start Date/ Time
